pages.text:
The face of performance.
Driving the Audi TTS with its race-bred heritage, it’s easy to trace its inspiration.
It begins with the 265 hp 2.0 liter TFSI® engine, which has been exclusively
re-engineered to suit the TTS. An enhanced air intake and exhaust system, coupled
with a performance-optimized turbocharger allows the TTS to tap the full potential
of turbo FSI® technology. The result is an astonishing 258 lb-ft. of torque from
2500-5000 rpm. The TTS also utilizes Audi launch control, which adds to its instinct
of speed by optimizing acceleration from a standstill. Just more proof that the
Audi TTS delivers on its promise of performance.
Audi TTS Coupe Prestige

TT Options TT Options
1 2
1. 18" fi ve-arm Dynamic Design alloy wheels with 245/40 summer
performance tires* | This option gives the TT a sport-inspired look and
feel, and comes equipped with summer performance tires, which help
to improve handling and driving dynamics.
2. Baseball optic Leather Package | The superior quality of Fine Nappa
leather seating surfaces adds to a sophisticated yet performance-oriented
driving experience. The Baseball Optic woven stitching evokes the original
heritage of the TT while adding an exclusive touch of distinction.
[Premium Plus and Prestige only; Black is available for Coupe,
Madras Brown is available for Roadster]
3. Audi magnetic ride | Instead of conventional damper oil, the shocks
are fi lled with a special fl uid where viscosity can be controlled by
an electromagnetic fi eld. The TT continuously adjusts the fl uid’s
electromagnetic properties to deliver the appropriate damping forces
in every driving situation. The driver can manually select “Normal” or
“Sport” mode in milliseconds with the touch of a button.
+ Fine nappa leather | The use of high-quality Fine Nappa leather
in the interior of the TT adds to the elegant, dynamic and sporty
driving experience. [Premium Plus and Prestige only]
3
* See page 28 for important safety information regarding summer performance tires.
+ FEAtURE not Shown

TTS Prestige | Options TTS Prestige
1 3 4
1. Audi navigation plus | The DVD-based Audi Navigation plus features a
full-color, six-and-one-quarter-inch LCD screen and MMI®-inspired control
logic for AM/FM radio and SIRIUS® Satellite Radio functions. Also included
are two SD® card slots for your MP3 music and the option of a six-CD changer
or iPod® interface.
2. BoSE® sound system with AudioPilot® | The twelve speakers include
a center speaker and subwoofer matched with an eight-channel DSP
amplifier with a total output of 255 watts. A microphone measures noise
level and adjusts radio volume accordingly, resulting in balanced sound,
despite background noise.
3. 19" five-tri-spoke wheels with summer performance tires* | The 19"
wheels enhance the purposeful stance of the TTS. The dynamic design
is optimized with summer performance tires, which help to improve
handling and driving dynamics.
+ Silk nappa Leather Package | The high-quality Silk Nappa leather and
contrast stitching enhance the sophisticated yet sport-oriented driving
2 experience of the TTS. Available in Black and bicolor leather.
+ ten-way power heated seats | The power heated seats allow the driver
and passenger to electronically adjust the seat’s forward/backward
position, seat height, lumbar support, and angle of seat cushion and
seatback. The multilevel seat-heating system is designed to heat the
entire surface of the seat; warming is initiated with a convenient button.
+ Auto-dimming interior mirror with compass | The rearview mirror with
automatic dimming recognizes glaringly bright beams behind the car and
darkens the mirror automatically. Vehicle direction is displayed through
a digital compass in the corner of the mirror.
TTS Options
4. Baseball optic Leather Package | The superior quality of Fine Nappa
leather seating surfaces adds to a sophisticated yet performance-oriented
driving experience. The Baseball Optic woven stitching evokes the original
heritage of the TTS while adding an exclusive touch of distinction. [Prestige
only; Black is available for Coupe, Madras Brown is available for Roadster]
* See page 28 for important safety information regarding summer performance tires.
+ FEAtURE not Shown
